input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this expression redundantly combines a historical time noun with a “time of” phrase. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，use this form when referring to a group of people. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，here the mother sees and realizes the classmates’ influence; 看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see/perceive.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：一个叫孟子的小男孩很小的时候，on first mention, introduce the character with a full noun phrase rather than only a name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：所以她带着他搬家了，after both characters have just been mentioned, use pronouns rather than repeating their names. [rule: redundancy_delete]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：他的同学们老是对他开玩笑，老是 describes a repeated routine, so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜，虽然 needs a contrasting second clause with 但是 or 可是; this sentence instead gives a cause with 因为. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
人 is too generic for this concrete group; 人们 is required here.
看到 means to see/perceive the influence, whereas 看 only means to look.
On his first appearance, the character should be introduced with a fuller identifying noun phrase.
Repeating both names immediately after mentioning them is redundant, and 她带着他 clearly refers to the mother and Mencius.
老是 marks a habitual action, so sentence-final 了 should not be used.
Although does not express the intended cause relationship, while 因为 correctly introduces the reason.
